title: EBC 908: Electrical
officialText:
908.1 General.

All electrical equipment and wiring within work areas shall comply with all applicable requirements of the New York City Electrical Code, this section and Sections 308 and 808 of this code.

908.1.1 Compliance of the entire electrical system as new construction.

Where the building is undergoing a Level 2 alteration and the work area exceeds 75 percent of the building area, the entire electrical system shall comply with the provisions of the New York City Electrical Code for new construction.
